steps.en: System detects the registered address has changed
steps.id: Sistem mendeteksi alamat terdaftar telah berubah
steps.why_en: No comparison of old and new address exists, so a change is never flagged.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada perbandingan alamat lama dan baru, jadi perubahan tidak pernah ditandai.

steps.en: The latest registered address becomes the letter address
steps.id: Alamat terdaftar terbaru menjadi alamat surat
steps.why_en: Only the regular path updates the notice, skips suspended notices, and the job is off in production.
steps.why_id: Hanya jalur reguler yang memperbarui notice, melewati notice suspended, dan job mati di produksi.

steps.en: System regenerates the reminder letter as a data file
steps.id: Sistem membuat ulang surat reminder sebagai file data
steps.why_en: Daily letter generation is commented out; letters only come from a manual trigger.
steps.why_id: Pembuatan surat harian dikomentari; surat hanya terbit lewat trigger manual.

steps.en: The file is sent to the vendor for printing and postage
steps.id: File dikirim ke vendor untuk dicetak dan dipos
steps.why_en: Upload to the print vendor is switched off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Upload ke vendor cetak dimatikan di setelan produksi.
